hero.headline: {tagline}
hero.subline: A regenerative village{in-location} where all beings **belong** and **thrive**. Start here: pick your path.

journey.heading: From First Visit to Home
journey.intro: Each stage is a chance to get to know each other. You figure out if {village} fits your life; we figure out if you're a good fit for the village.

paths.heading: Choose your path
paths.intro: Four ways into {village}. Pick the one that fits you today. You can add more later.

cards.title: Investor
cards.subtitle: Capital Contributor
cards.description: Plant capital in a project built to last. The village grows, community ownership stays intact, and returns and values move in the same direction.

cards.title: Village Steward
cards.subtitle: Co-Creator
cards.description: Hold a role, join a circle, and keep the whole village running.

cards.title: Resident
cards.subtitle: Co-Creator
cards.description: Make {village} your home. Find a place to live, join the waitlist, and belong.

cards.title: Prosperity Creator
cards.subtitle: Business Builder
cards.description: Launch or grow your business inside the village, and share in what you build.

personas.heading: Who Comes to {village}?
personas.intro: {village} attracts people who are done half-living. Here are some of the souls who find their way here.
personas.footer: See yourself here? There's a path with your name on it.

items.label: Digital Nomad Couple
items.body: Location-independent professionals ready to stop bouncing between Airbnbs and plant themselves somewhere with depth, community, and a reason to stay.

items.label: Worldschooling Family
items.body: Families who want their children raised by a community, surrounded by nature, multi-generational wisdom, and real-world learning instead of a system.

items.label: Retiree & Snowbird
items.tagline: Finally, a second chapter worth living.
items.body: Post-career dreamers who want warmth, beauty, belonging, and a role that still matters, not a golf course.

items.label: Longevity Seeker
items.tagline: I want to live well, not just long.
items.body: Health-conscious individuals chasing clean air, organic food, movement, community, and purpose as medicine: building a life designed to thrive.

items.label: Remote Exec & Founder
items.tagline: I built the life. Now I want meaning.
items.body: High-achievers who want their next chapter to matter: contributing capital, skills, or leadership to something regenerative and lasting.

items.label: Regional Changemaker
items.tagline: I want to build something here.
items.body: Local and regional changemakers who see {village} as the proving ground for a regenerative future in their own part of the world, and want to help shape it.

cta.heading: Ready to Begin Your Journey?
cta.body: Join our next community call to learn about the basics and ask any questions. It's the perfect first step on any path.
